A kiln-house is a dwelling fired like a pot. The walls are brick the color of dried apricot. The roof is a shallow dome. In the first years of [[Ember Reach]], the same chamber baked bread, bricks, and sleep.

When the river still ran, heat was easy to invite. After [[The River Runs Dry]], many chimneys went cold. Families who keep [[The Hearth Compact]] will not force a fire in a house that has not asked for one. They visit the lodge instead, and come home with warm hands and a quieter room.

[[Mira Vale]]'s house is one of these. She writes at a table that still smells faintly of yeast.
